title: Slimmer file/folder right-click menus
description:
Right-clicking a file or folder now shows only File Actions (download, rename, cut, copy, move, delete, etc.). Share, Workspace, Admin tools extras, DB3, and Folder system stay on empty-space right-click so the row menus stay uncluttered.

Who is affected: PipeShare BASE after deploy; SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Empty-space right-click keeps Share, Workspace, Create, support, DB3, Folder system.
Folder system switch no longer appears on row menus.
